_rules: Claude may ONLY change the 'passes' field. Never delete, reword or reorder features; propose changes in decisions.md instead.
Set 'passes' to true only after the 'verify' command ran green in the same session and its output is quoted in progress.md.
verify prefixes: 'cmd:' run the command; 'e2e:' Playwright spec; 'sql:' pgTAP file run by npx supabase test db; 'manual:' a human step recorded in progress.md.
'ci:' = the GitHub Actions 'Check' workflow is green on the slice PR and includes the named test (used for checks that need Docker: migrations, pgTAP, Playwright).
MVP features (slices M0-M5) come first. Full-build features that the MVP already covers are listed in TRANSITION.md section 2 and are re-verified, not rebuilt.
